headline: Evergreen Marine September revenue hits NT$49.71 billion, two-year high; CEO: no reason to be pessimistic about US routes before Spring Festival | ETtoday Finance Cloud | ETtoday News Cloud
summary: Evergreen Marine reported consolidated September revenue of NT$49.71 billion, up 1.48% month on month and over 60% year on year. The figure is the highest since September 2024 on sustained high cargo volumes.
why: Evergreen Marine is a major Taiwanese container shipping line, so its monthly revenue reflects global container freight demand and rates.
